goal: Prevent fee-bumped wallet transactions from picking an older locktime than the transaction they replace
Stop an on-chain fingerprint identifying replaced transactions as coming from Bitcoin Core or Electrum
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Strong support after addressing test and stale-tip edge cases (molnard, nervana21, polespinasa)
Verified by code review and passing new unit and functional tests locally (molnard, nervana21)
Open suggestion to place locktime handling inside the anti-fee-sniping block (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes an on-chain privacy leak that fingerprints wallet fee bumps as Bitcoin Core or Electrum
Affects hundreds of weekly RBF replacements, removing an identifiable pattern from transaction creation
